# P398: Clickable Session Round History with Summary Screen — Acceptance Tests

**Purpose:** Testable acceptance criteria for clicking into completed round history and viewing the summary screen.
**Usage:** Ralph Loop iterates until ALL tests pass (score 100%).
**Source:** features/p398_session-history-round-summary.md
**Generated:** 2026-02-19
**Generated by:** /generate-tests

---

## Test Scoring

Score = passed_tests / 14 (shown as X/14 or N%)
Total tests: 14
Pass threshold: 14/14 (100% — all tests must pass)

---

## Category 1: Completed Round History Entry (4 tests)

### UAT-1.1: Completed entry shows chevron affordance (not clickable before P398)
**Requires:** two-party
**Given:** A round completes naturally (both click Continue on celebration screen)
**When:** Both participants return to the idle screen
**Then:**
- The round appears in "THIS SESSION" history list
- The entry has a right-chevron icon (e.g. `›` or `>`) on the right side
- The entry is a button element (tappable on touch, focusable on keyboard)
- The title text is visible and truncated with ellipsis if long

**Verify:** Playwright MCP — complete one round, check history list shows button with aria-label starting with "View round summary:"

---

### UAT-1.2: Completed entry has accessible name for screen readers
**Requires:** two-party
**Given:** A completed round is in the history list
**When:** A screen reader (or accessibility audit) inspects the interactive element
**Then:**
- The element's accessible name is `"View round summary: [story/point title]"`
- The name starts with "View round summary:" so it describes both the action AND the content

**Verify:** Playwright MCP — check `aria-label` attribute: `getByRole('button', { name: /View round summary:/i })`

---

### UAT-1.3: Clicking completed entry does NOT navigate away from /live
**Requires:** two-party
**Given:** A completed round is in the history list
**When:** User taps the history entry button
**Then:**
- The page URL remains at `/live/[code]` (no navigation)
- The `LiveHeader` (partner name + Leave button) remains visible unchanged
- Only the scrollable body content changes (idle content replaced by summary)

**Verify:** Playwright MCP — click history entry, check URL unchanged, check header still visible

---

### UAT-1.4: Multiple completed entries — each opens its own summary
**Requires:** two-party
**Given:** Two or more rounds have been completed in the session
**When:** User taps the second (older) history entry
**Then:**
- The summary screen shows the title and journey data for THAT round (not the most recent)
- The correct checker/responder ratings for that specific round are displayed
- Back returns to idle with all history entries still visible

**Verify:** Playwright MCP — complete 2 rounds, tap the first entry, verify its ratings, tap Back, tap the second entry, verify different ratings

---

## Category 2: Round Summary Screen (4 tests)

### UAT-2.1: Summary screen shows the correct celebration content
**Requires:** two-party
**Given:** A round completed with checker_rating=8 and responder_rating=7
**When:** User taps the history entry
**Then:**
- The summary screen shows the `JourneyToUnderstanding` component (the same celebration screen)
- Rating values 8 (checker) and 7 (responder) are visible as numbers in the journey card
- The story/point title is visible as a heading
- No "rating input" or submit buttons — this is a read-only view

**Verify:** Playwright MCP — complete round with 8+7, open summary, verify numbers 8 and 7 visible in journey display

---

### UAT-2.2: Summary screen has a "Back" button that restores idle content
**Given:** The summary screen is open
**When:** User taps the "Back" button
**Then:**
- The idle content is restored immediately
- The action buttons (Does X understand you? / Does Y understand you?) are visible again
- The history list is still visible with the same entries
- The Back button is gone (replaced by idle content)
- The session state is completely unchanged (can still start a new round)

**Verify:** Playwright MCP — open summary, click Back, verify action buttons visible, verify no Back button

---

### UAT-2.3: Summary screen is not accessible during an active round
**Requires:** two-party
**Given:** A round has been completed and is in history; a new round is now active
**When:** User tries to view history while `ratingPhase !== 'idle'` (rating/waiting/revealed)
**Then:**
- The history list is not visible (idle screen is replaced by active round UI)
- No history entry buttons are accessible during an active round

**Verify:** Playwright MCP — start new round, verify no history list visible, verify no "View round summary:" buttons accessible

---

### UAT-2.4: Summary does not disrupt session state
**Requires:** two-party
**Given:** User opens and closes the summary screen
**When:** User starts a new round after viewing the summary
**Then:**
- The new round starts normally (both see the rating UI)
- No state corruption from the summary view
- The session history grows by 1 after the new round completes

**Verify:** Playwright MCP — open summary, Back, complete another round, verify history now has 2 entries

---

## Category 3: Skipped Rounds (2 tests)

### UAT-3.1: Skipped round entry has no chevron and is visually muted
**Given:** A round was skipped by either participant
**When:** The user views the "THIS SESSION" history list
**Then:**
- The skipped entry appears in the list (round is not hidden)
- The entry shows a "Skipped" label (right-aligned, small, muted color)
- There is NO chevron icon on the skipped entry
- The entry text and icons use reduced opacity or muted color

**Verify:** Playwright MCP — skip a round, check history list for "Skipped" label, verify no chevron icon element

---

### UAT-3.2: Tapping a skipped entry does nothing (no crash, no summary)
**Given:** A skipped round is in the "THIS SESSION" history list
**When:** User taps on the skipped entry (touch or click)
**Then:**
- Nothing happens — no summary opens, no error, no navigation
- The idle screen content is unchanged
- No JavaScript console errors

**Verify:** Playwright MCP — click on skipped entry text/area, verify Back button NOT present, verify no console errors

---

## Category 4: Keyboard and Accessibility (2 tests)

### UAT-4.1: Escape key closes the summary screen
**Given:** The summary screen is open
**When:** User presses the Escape key
**Then:**
- The summary screen closes immediately
- Same effect as clicking the Back button
- Idle content is restored

**Verify:** Playwright MCP — open summary, press Escape, verify Back button gone, verify idle content visible

---

### UAT-4.2: History row button is keyboard accessible (Tab → focus → Enter → opens summary)
**Given:** A completed round is in the history list
**When:** User navigates to the history row button via Tab key and presses Enter
**Then:**
- The history row button receives focus (visible focus ring)
- Pressing Enter activates the button and opens the summary screen
- Space key also works (native button behavior)

**Verify:** Playwright MCP — `historyButton.focus()`, verify `toBeFocused()`, press Enter, verify summary opens

---

## Category 5: Session State Boundaries (2 tests)

### UAT-5.1: Summary auto-closes when partner starts a new round
**Requires:** two-party
**Given:** User A has the summary screen open; User B is on the idle screen
**When:** User B clicks an action button to start a new round
**Then:**
- User A's summary screen closes automatically (no action from User A)
- User A sees the active round UI immediately
- No data is lost; session state is unaffected

**Verify:** Two-browser Playwright MCP — User A opens summary, User B clicks action button, verify User A's summary closes and rating UI shows

---

### UAT-5.2: Session history is cleared on page reload (in-memory only)
**Given:** A session with completed rounds in history
**When:** Creator reloads the /live page (navigates to /live fresh, same session code not preserved)
**Then:**
- The history list is empty (no "THIS SESSION" section shown)
- This confirms history is in-memory only (as specified) — no cross-session persistence
- The fresh page load shows the pre-session state (no active session)

**Verify:** Playwright MCP — complete a round, reload page, verify no history entries visible
